title: 🔥 IT IS FINISHED: THE POWERFUL TRUTH OF JESUS’ FINAL WORDS!
paragraphs:
🔥 IT IS FINISHED: THE POWERFUL TRUTH OF JESUS’ FINAL WORDS!
💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, when Jesus said ‘It is finished’ on the cross, what exactly did He mean? Was He just talking about His suffering, or was there a deeper meaning?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people hear the words "It is finished" but don’t fully understand their power. This was not just a statement of death—it was a declaration of victory!

📖 John 19:30 (KJV)
"When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost."
🚨 WHAT DID JESUS MEAN BY ‘IT IS FINISHED’?

✔️ He was NOT saying His life was over—He was declaring that His mission was completed!
✔️ He was NOT defeated—He had just won the greatest victory in history!
✔️ He was NOT just speaking for Himself—He was speaking for all who would believe in Him!
🔥 "IT IS FINISHED" MEANS THE DEBT OF SIN HAS BEEN PAID IN FULL!
💡 QUESTION: Do you truly understand the depth of what Jesus accomplished for you on the cross?
WHAT WAS FINISHED AT THE CROSS?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, when Jesus said ‘It is finished,’ what exactly was He referring to? What was completed at that moment?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Jesus was not simply saying His earthly life was ending—He was declaring the completion of God’s plan for salvation!

📖 Colossians 2:14 (KJV)
"Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross."
🚨 WHAT WAS FINISHED AT THE CROSS?

✔️ 1️⃣ THE PAYMENT FOR SIN WAS COMPLETED! – The debt of sin was fully paid by Jesus’ blood.
📖 Romans 6:23 (KJV) – "For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord."

✔️ 2️⃣ THE POWER OF THE LAW WAS SATISFIED! – The law demanded justice, and Jesus fulfilled it.
📖 Matthew 5:17 (KJV) – "Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfill."

✔️ 3️⃣ SATAN’S DOMINION WAS BROKEN! – The enemy lost his power over those who are in Christ.
📖 Hebrews 2:14 (KJV) – "That through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil."

✔️ 4️⃣ THE PROPHECIES WERE FULFILLED! – Everything written about the Messiah’s suffering was completed.
📖 Isaiah 53:5 (KJV) – "But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities."

✔️ 5️⃣ ACCESS TO GOD WAS RESTORED! – The veil in the temple was torn, symbolizing direct access to the Father.
📖 Matthew 27:51 (KJV) – "And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom."
🔥 "IT IS FINISHED" MEANS THAT NOTHING ELSE NEEDS TO BE ADDED—JESUS PAID IT ALL!

📖 Ephesians 1:7 (KJV)
"In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace."
🚨 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN FOR US?

✔️ We do NOT need religious rituals to be saved—Jesus’ work is enough!
✔️ We do NOT have to live under guilt and condemnation—the debt is paid!
✔️ We do NOT have to fear the devil—his power is broken!
🔥 THE CROSS CHANGED EVERYTHING—WILL YOU WALK IN THE VICTORY JESUS GAVE YOU?
💡 QUESTION: Are you still trying to earn salvation, or have you fully accepted that Jesus paid it all?
WHAT DOES ‘IT IS FINISHED’ MEAN FOR US TODAY?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, if Jesus finished everything on the cross, what does that mean for my life today? How should I live knowing this truth?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people believe in Jesus but still live as if they need to earn God’s approval. They carry guilt, fear, and religious burdens that Jesus already took away!

📖 Romans 8:1 (KJV)
"There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit."
🚨 WHAT DOES ‘IT IS FINISHED’ MEAN FOR US TODAY?

✔️ 1️⃣ WE ARE SAVED BY GRACE, NOT WORKS! – You cannot earn salvation; it’s a free gift.
📖 Ephesians 2:8-9 (KJV) – "For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast."

✔️ 2️⃣ WE HAVE COMPLETE FORGIVENESS! – Every sin—past, present, and future—was paid for.
📖 Colossians 1:14 (KJV) – "In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins."

✔️ 3️⃣ WE HAVE AUTHORITY OVER THE ENEMY! – The devil’s power is broken for those in Christ.
📖 Luke 10:19 (KJV) – "Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy."

✔️ 4️⃣ WE HAVE DIRECT ACCESS TO GOD! – No need for priests, rituals, or religious systems.
📖 Hebrews 4:16 (KJV) – "Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace."

✔️ 5️⃣ WE CAN LIVE IN PEACE AND FREEDOM! – Fear, anxiety, and shame have no place in a believer’s life.
📖 John 14:27 (KJV) – "Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you."
🔥 "IT IS FINISHED" MEANS YOU CAN REST IN JESUS—YOUR SALVATION IS SECURE!

📖 Galatians 5:1 (KJV)
"Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage."
🚨 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN FOR US?

✔️ Stop trying to earn what Jesus already gave you!
✔️ Stop carrying guilt—your debt is paid!
✔️ Live in the victory Jesus won for you!
🔥 WILL YOU WALK IN THE FREEDOM THAT JESUS DIED TO GIVE YOU?
💡 QUESTION: Are you living in the finished work of Christ, or are you still trapped in religion and fear?

FINAL CHALLENGE – WILL YOU LIVE IN THE POWER OF ‘IT IS FINISHED’?

💭 THE MOMENT OF DECISION IS HERE!
Now that you understand what Jesus truly meant when He declared "It is finished," the question is: Will you accept His finished work and walk in victory, or will you keep living as if you still need to earn salvation?

📖 John 8:36 (KJV)
"If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed."
🚨 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?

✔️ Will you trust that Jesus’ sacrifice was enough?
✔️ Will you stop carrying guilt and shame that Jesus already took away?
✔️ Will you boldly proclaim that you are free in Christ?
🔥 THE DEVIL WANTS YOU TO DOUBT THE FINISHED WORK OF JESUS—BUT IT IS TRULY FINISHED!

📖 2 Corinthians 5:17 (KJV)
"Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new."
💡 QUESTION: Are you ready to walk in the power of the cross and claim your victory in Jesus?

🚨 CHOOSE NOW:
❌ Keep living under fear, guilt, and religious bondage.
✔️ Embrace the finished work of Christ and walk in true freedom!
🔥 JESUS PAID IT ALL—NOW LIVE IN HIS FREEDOM!

PRAYER OF THANKSGIVING FOR THE FINISHED WORK OF CHRIST!
"Heavenly Father, I thank You for the perfect sacrifice of Jesus Christ. I declare that His work on the cross is complete, and I will not live in fear, guilt, or bondage. I am forgiven, redeemed, and made new by His blood. Lord, help me to walk in the freedom that Jesus has already won for me. Fill me with boldness to share this truth with others, so they, too, may know the power of ‘It is finished.’ In Jesus’ mighty name, AMEN!"
PROOF, SOURCES & BIBLICAL EVIDENCE – THE POWER OF ‘IT IS FINISHED’!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, is there solid biblical proof that ‘It is finished’ means Jesus paid for everything? Can we be sure that nothing else is required for salvation?"
🚨 THE TRUTH: EVERYTHING WE TEACH IS ROOTED IN SCRIPTURE & VERIFIED BY HISTORY!

📖 Hebrews 9:12 (KJV)
"Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us."

✅ BIBLICAL PROOF – JESUS PAID IT ALL!
📖 JESUS FULFILLED THE LAW COMPLETELY!
✔️ Matthew 5:17 (KJV) – "Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfill."
💡 Lesson: Jesus finished what the Old Testament sacrifices could not do—He became the final atonement!

📖 WE ARE SAVED BY FAITH ALONE IN CHRIST!
✔️ Ephesians 2:8-9 (KJV) – "For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast."
💡 Lesson: Jesus’ death was enough—our works do not add to salvation!

📖 HIS BLOOD WAS THE FINAL SACRIFICE!
✔️ John 1:29 (KJV) – "Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world."
💡 Lesson: The Old Testament sacrifices were temporary, but Jesus’ sacrifice is eternal!

📖 SATAN’S POWER WAS DESTROYED AT THE CROSS!
✔️ Colossians 2:15 (KJV) – "And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it."
💡 Lesson: Jesus’ victory was not just over sin—it was over Satan himself!

✅ HISTORICAL PROOF – CHRISTIANS HAVE ALWAYS TAUGHT ‘IT IS FINISHED’!
📜 "The Early Church Fathers" – Writings from early Christians confirm that salvation is complete in Christ alone.
📜 "Foxe’s Book of Martyrs" – John Foxe – Documents how believers stood on the finished work of Christ, even under persecution.
📜 "The Protestant Reformation" – A movement that restored the biblical truth that Jesus’ work is complete.

🔥 This is your moment to act! Choose to stand on the finished work of Christ and share this truth with the world!
